sourceText:
Nam Pla Wan
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 11:09pm

Ingredients




1 Onion, chopped
8 Garlic, minced
1 tablespoon Hot pepper flakes
1/4 cup Nam pla
1 tablespoon Brown sugar
2 tablespoons Orange juice concentrate
2 Scallions, chopped
1 tablespoon Coriander leaves

Preparation

1 Fry onion and garlic until golden. Add hot pepper flakes. Leave on burner but turn off heat. 2 Boil rest of ingredients together. When the mixture comes to a boil, add the onion mixture. Serve immediately.
